		<description>The Xiangshan County Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for strong winds at 06:36 on October 27, 2026: Due to the influence of cold air, it is expected that there will be 7-9 level northerly winds on the coastal sea surface of our county today, and 6-8 level winds in coastal towns and townships (streets) such as Hepu, Shipu, Gaotang Island, Dongchen, Tuci, Juexi, and Xianxiang.
